# Sabita Traders (full content) – authorised John Deere tractor dealer, Berhampur (Ganjam, Odisha)

> Sabita Traders, in Brahmapur (Berhampur), is the only authorised John Deere tractor dealer for Ganjam district, Odisha, India. Tractor sales, loans, old-tractor exchange, a John Deere service workshop and genuine parts are at one site.

## Key facts
- Address: NH5 Pathara Byepass Junction, Dura Bahadurpeta, Brahmapur, Odisha 760007, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 89085 89085 (second phone: +91 93375 00337)
- Email: 1sabitatraders@gmail.com
- Open: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 8 PM (closed Sunday)
- Areas served: Berhampur, Aska, Bhanjanagar and the rest of Ganjam district
- Tractors: John Deere 5039D PowerPro 2WD (41 HP), 5045D PowerPro and GearPro (46 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5050D PowerPro and GearPro (50 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5105 (40 HP, 2WD and 4WD)
- Finance partners (11): John Deere Financial India Pvt Ltd, State Bank of India, Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, IndusInd Bank, HDFC Bank, DCB Bank, Shriram Finance, Sundaram Finance, L&T Finance, Cholamandalam Finance
- Warranty: John Deere tractors carry a 5-year / 5,000-hour warranty, free and transferable, valid with scheduled service at an authorised workshop
- Indicative tractor prices, tractor only (lower figure is after the Odisha government subsidy, subject to eligibility and DBT approval: ₹1.2 lakh up to 48 HP, ₹1.5 lakh from 50 HP; upper figure is the MRP): 5105 ₹6.20 – 8.80 lakh (2WD ₹6.20 – 7.40, 4WD ₹7.60 – 8.80); 5039D PowerPro 2WD ₹6.40 – 7.60 lakh; 5045D PowerPro ₹7.40 – 10.00 lakh (2WD ₹7.40 – 8.60, 4WD ₹8.80 – 10.00); 5050D ₹7.80 – 11.00 lakh (2WD ₹7.80 – 9.30, 4WD ₹9.50 – 11.00)
- Implements, fitments and accessories cost extra. On-road price (with registration and insurance) is quoted on request on WhatsApp +91 89085 89085. EMI and exchange values from the website calculators are indicative

### Questions farmers ask.

Which John Deere tractor suits paddy and wet land?

The 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP) is our best seller in Ganjam. John Deere fits the 4WD version with high-lug tyres for wet land, and also makes a Puddling Special version. We will suggest the right one for your land on a test drive.

Can I take a loan and the Odisha subsidy together?

Yes, under the Odisha DBT farm mechanisation scheme. Start your loan file before booking on the Go-Sugam portal: your bank must issue the delivery order within the 45-day permit window. Our team helps with both.

What warranty comes with a John Deere tractor?

5 years or 5,000 hours, free and transferable, as long as the tractor is serviced on schedule. Accessories and optional attachments are covered separately.

Where can I service my tractor?

At our workshop on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Dura Bahadurpeta, Brahmapur, open Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM. WhatsApp 89085 89085 to book.

## John Deere 5045D PowerPro

The John Deere 5045D PowerPro is a 46 HP D Series tractor, available in 2WD and 4WD. The 4WD version, with high-lug tyres for wet land, is our best seller in Ganjam. It is built for ploughing, tilling and haulage. Get the on-road price and EMI at Sabita Traders, Berhampur.

Choose drive4WD: the front wheels also drive; bigger 8.0 x 18 front tyres. Our best seller for wet land in Ganjam.

### Questions about the 5045D PowerPro

What is the price of the 5045D PowerPro in Ganjam?

The indicative price for the tractor only is ₹7.40 – 10.00 lakh: 2WD ₹7.40 – 8.60 lakh, 4WD ₹8.80 – 10.00 lakh. The lower figure is after the ₹1.2 lakh Odisha government subsidy (subject to eligibility and DBT approval), and the upper figure is the MRP. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

What does the price of the 5045D PowerPro include?

The price is for the tractor only. Implements, fitments and accessories cost extra. Registration and insurance are added in the on-road price, which we quote on request. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

Do you sell both the PowerPro and GearPro variants of the 5045D?

Yes. We sell both the PowerPro and the GearPro variants of the 5045D. The GearPro costs about ₹30,000 more; the prices above are for the PowerPro. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for the exact price and specification of each.

What is the difference between the 5045D 2WD and 4WD?

On the 2WD, the engine drives only the two big rear wheels and the front wheels just steer. The 4WD also drives the front wheels, which are bigger (8.0 x 18 against 6.0 x 16 on the 2WD) for more grip. John Deere lists a dual clutch on the 4WD and a single or dual clutch on the 2WD.

Who should choose the 5045D 2WD?

Farmers who work mainly on dry land, grow rabi crops, or use the tractor for sugarcane haulage and trolley transport. The 2WD usually costs less, is simpler and cheaper to maintain, and turns easily.

Is the 5045D PowerPro good for paddy puddling?

Yes. John Deere makes a 5045D PowerPro Puddling Special 4WD for wet paddy fields, and the 4WD version is our best seller for wet land in Ganjam. We help you choose on a test drive.

What is the EMI on the 5045D PowerPro?

It depends on the price, down payment, interest rate and tenure. Use the EMI calculator on this page for an indicative figure; your financier confirms the final EMI.

Where can I service the 5045D PowerPro near me?

At our authorised John Deere workshop on NH5 Pathara Byepass, Berhampur, open Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM.

## John Deere 5105

The John Deere 5105 is a 40 HP tractor that John Deere describes as suitable for both dry and wet farming. Its 3-cylinder, 2900 cc engine runs at 2100 RPM with high torque for heavy loads. It comes in 2WD and 4WD. Get the on-road price and EMI at Sabita Traders, Berhampur.

Choose drive4WD: the front wheels also drive; bigger 8.0 x 18 front tyres. Best grip for wet paddy and puddling.

### Questions about the 5105

What is the price of the 5105 in Ganjam?

WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

What does the price of the 5105 include?

The price is for the tractor only. Implements, fitments and accessories cost extra. Registration and insurance are added in the on-road price, which we quote on request. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

What is the difference between the 5105 2WD and 4WD?

On the 2WD, the engine drives only the two big rear wheels and the front wheels just steer. The 4WD also drives the front wheels, which are bigger (8.0 x 18 against 6.0 x 16 on the 2WD) for more grip.

Who should choose the 5105 2WD?

Farmers who work mainly on dry land, grow rabi crops, or use the tractor for sugarcane haulage and trolley transport. The 2WD usually costs less, is simpler and cheaper to maintain, and turns easily.

Can I use the 5105 2WD in wet paddy fields?

For wet paddy, puddling and soft land, the 4WD gives much better grip and is less likely to get stuck. If you do both dry and wet work, choose the 4WD if your budget allows, or ask us about the 5105 Puddling Special.

Is the 5105 good for paddy puddling?

John Deere makes a 5105 Puddling Special version for paddy fields. See its leaflet on this page, or ask us for a demo.

### Questions about the 5039D PowerPro 2WD

What is the price of the 5039D PowerPro in Ganjam?

The indicative price for the tractor only (2WD) is ₹6.40 – 7.60 lakh. The lower figure is after the ₹1.2 lakh Odisha government subsidy (subject to eligibility and DBT approval), and the upper figure is the MRP. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

What does the price of the 5039D PowerPro include?

The price is for the tractor only. Implements, fitments and accessories cost extra. Registration and insurance are added in the on-road price, which we quote on request. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

Is the 5039D available in 4WD?

John Deere India lists the 5039D PowerPro as a 2WD tractor. For wet paddy work, see the 5045D PowerPro 4WD or the 5105 4WD.

What does PowerPro mean?

PowerPro models have a dual clutch and dual PTO. The dual clutch lets you stop the tractor without stopping the PTO, so implements such as a rotavator keep running.

What is the EMI on the 5039D PowerPro?

It depends on the price, down payment, interest rate and tenure. Use the EMI calculator on this page for an indicative figure; your financier confirms the final EMI.

### Questions about choosing a model

Which John Deere tractor suits paddy and wet land?

The 5045D PowerPro 4WD (46 HP) is our best seller in Ganjam. John Deere fits the 4WD version with high-lug tyres for wet land, and also makes a Puddling Special version. We will suggest the right one for your land on a test drive.

Is the 5039D available in 4WD?

John Deere India lists the 5039D PowerPro as a 2WD tractor. For wet paddy work, look at the 5045D PowerPro 4WD or the 5105 4WD.

Should I take 2WD or 4WD?

On the 2WD, the engine drives only the two big rear wheels and the front wheels just steer. The 4WD also drives the front wheels for more grip, which helps in wet paddy, puddling and soft land. The 2WD suits dry land, rabi crops, sugarcane haulage and trolley transport.

Do all four models have the same warranty?

Yes. All four carry John Deere’s 5-year / 5,000-hour warranty, free and transferable, as long as the tractor is serviced on schedule.

What are the prices of these tractors in Ganjam?

Indicative prices for the tractor only: 5105 ₹6.20 – 8.80 lakh, 5039D PowerPro ₹6.40 – 7.60 lakh, 5045D PowerPro ₹7.40 – 10.00 lakh and 5050D ₹7.80 – 11.00 lakh. The lower figure is after the Odisha government subsidy, subject to eligibility and DBT approval (₹1.2 lakh up to 48 HP, ₹1.5 lakh for the 5050D); the upper figure is the MRP. Implements and accessories cost extra. WhatsApp 89085 89085 for today’s on-road price in Ganjam.

### Odisha DBT subsidy: how it works

1. Register on Krushak Odisha with your Aadhaar, land details and mobile number.
2. Apply for the machine on the Government's farm-machinery DBT portal. Our team helps you through each step.
3. If you take a loan, start the loan file before booking. The permit is valid for 45 days in loan cases.
4. After delivery and verification, the subsidy is paid to your Aadhaar-linked bank account.

### What changes the value.

Age matters most. Then hours run, condition, tyres and papers. A well-kept tractor with its service record and RC always gets a better price.

* **Age**Biggest factor; value falls fastest in the first 5 years
* **Hours run**High hours for its age lower the value
* **Condition**Leaks, smoke and repairs lower the value
* **Tyres**Worn tyres are deducted at replacement cost
* **Papers**RC is required; a service record helps

FARMER GUIDES

### From choosing a tractor to owning it.

Tap a step in your buying journey to read how it works.

FINANCE

#### How a tractor loan works

Most farmers buy with a loan. The bank or finance company pays the dealer, you pay a down payment, and you repay in instalments. Until the loan is closed, the lender’s name is noted on your tractor’s RC.

1. 1

   **Choose and get a quotation**
   Pick the tractor and implement with the dealer and take a written quotation.
2. 2

   **Apply to a lender**
   John Deere Financial, a bank or an NBFC checks your documents, credit history, land and farm income.
3. 3

   **Sanction and delivery order**
   Once sanctioned, the lender issues a delivery order and pays the dealer. You pay the down payment.
4. 4

   **Take delivery**
   The lender is recorded on the RC as hypothecation: you own and use the tractor; it is security for the loan.
5. 5

   **Repay**
   Pay instalments on time. Farm loans may offer quarterly or half-yearly instalments; ask your lender.
6. 6

   **Close and clear the RC**
   After the last instalment, get the lender’s NOC and apply with Form 35 to remove hypothecation from the RC.

DOCUMENTS USUALLY ASKED FOR

Aadhaar card
PAN card
Land records
Bank statements
Photographs
Address proof

GOOD TO KNOW

* Taking the Odisha DBT subsidy with a loan? Start the loan file before booking, because the bank must issue the delivery order within the 45-day permit.
* Paying on time keeps your credit record clean for future loans.
* Keep the NOC and loan-closure letter safely.

Sources: TractorJunction loan guide; Indian Bank farm machinery loan terms; Bajaj Finserv hypothecation guide; Govt of Odisha DBT-FM operational modality.
See finance options

ODISHA GOVERNMENT · FARM MECHANISATION

#### Government schemes for Ganjam farmers.

Tractors and implements bought under these schemes are subsidised through Odisha’s DBT farm mechanisation programme. Every district, Ganjam included, gets a yearly target for each machine. Subsidy amounts are set by the Government of Odisha.

ODISHA STATE PLAN
**Popularisation of Agricultural Implements, Equipment and Diesel Pump Sets**
The state’s main farm mechanisation scheme: tractors, rotavators, power tillers, combine harvesters and post-harvest machines. Extended by the Odisha Cabinet for 2026-27 to 2030-31.

GOVT OF INDIA · PM-RKVY
**Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanisation (SMAM)**
Central scheme for implements such as power tillers, rotavators, transplanters, threshers, balers and drones. Higher assistance for SC, ST, small and marginal, and women farmers.

GOVT OF INDIA
**National Food Security Mission (NFSM)**
Also funds farm machinery under Odisha’s DBT farm mechanisation programme.

ODISHA · MISSION SHAKTI
**Machinery for Women’s SHGs**
Women’s self-help groups can start agri-ventures by buying farm machinery, applying through a nominated member.

LATEST FROM THE AGRICULTURE DEPARTMENT

1 SEP 2026
**New booking round.** Bookings reopened phase-wise from 1 September 2026 after the target top-up.

25 AUG 2026
**Subsidy through Aadhaar.** Subsidy is now paid through the Aadhaar-Based Payment System. Link your Aadhaar to your bank account.

AUG 2026
**Scheme extended to 2031.** The Odisha Cabinet extended the state farm mechanisation scheme for five more years.

FY 2026-27
**New FM-DBT portal.** Farm machinery booking moved to fmdbt.agriodisha.nic.in from this financial year.

NOV 2025
**e-RUPI vouchers.** Eligible purchases can be paid with e-RUPI vouchers through onboarded dealers.

## John Deere 3036EN Narrow Orchard (35 HP) Specs, 4WD | Berhampur
URL: https://www.sabitatraders.com/john-deere-3036en.html

The John Deere 3036EN is a 35 HP narrow 4WD tractor with a Yanmar engine and 8 forward + 8 reverse gears, made to work between rows in orchards, plantations and vineyards. Get the on-road price and EMI at Sabita Traders, Berhampur.

Indicative price (tractor only): ₹8.10 – 9.30 lakh. Lower figure is after the ₹1.2 lakh Odisha government subsidy (subject to eligibility and DBT approval); upper figure is the MRP.

### Full specifications
Source: John Deere India, 3036EN specification (deere.co.in), November 2026.
- Engine power: 35 HP (27 kW)
- Engine: Yanmar 3TNV88-KJPT, 3 cylinders, naturally aspirated
- Rated RPM: 2800
- Air filter: Dry type, dual element
- Gearbox: 8 forward + 8 reverse, synchro reverser or collar reverser
- Lift capacity: 910 kg
- PTO: Independent, 6 splines
- Wheel drive: 4WD
- Warranty: 5 years / 5,000 hours

### Best suited for
- Orchards, plantations and vineyards: narrow enough to work between rows
- Spraying and inter-row cultivation
- Small plots where a bigger tractor cannot turn

## Odisha Tractor Subsidy 2026: How to Apply in Ganjam
URL: https://www.sabitatraders.com/odisha-tractor-subsidy-2026-guide.html

Home › Blog › Odisha tractor subsidy 2026

ODISHA SUBSIDY GUIDE · UPDATED 17 NOV 2026

## Odisha tractor subsidy 2026: how to apply in Ganjam
Under Odisha’s DBT farm mechanisation scheme, a Ganjam farmer gets ₹1,20,000 off a tractor up to 48 HP, or ₹1,50,000 for 50 HP and above, paid into the farmer’s Aadhaar-linked bank account. You book on the FM-DBT portal while Ganjam has target, choose an enlisted dealer, and finish payment and delivery within the permit’s validity.
By M Krishna Reddy, Managing Director, Sabita Traders · Published 17 Nov 2026 · 6 min read
WhatsApp for help applyingCheck your tractor’s HP band

## Quick answer
- Subsidy: ₹1,20,000 for tractors up to 48 HP; ₹1,50,000 for 50 HP and above (subject to eligibility and DBT approval).
- Where to apply: register once on Go-Sugam, then book on the FM-DBT portal (fmdbt.agriodisha.nic.in).
- Permit: valid 30 days if you pay yourself, 45 days with a bank loan.
- Next tractor target top-ups: 1 Dec and 15 Dec 2026, 1 Jan and 15 Jan 2027. Booking reopens at 3 PM on those days.
- Payment: the subsidy goes into your Aadhaar-linked bank account after the dealer’s verification.

## How much is the Odisha tractor subsidy in 2026?
The subsidy depends on the tractor’s engine power:
Tractor power | Subsidy | John Deere models in this band | 
Up to 48 HP | ₹1,20,000 | 3036EN (35 HP), 5036D (36 HP), 5105 (40 HP), 5039D PowerPro (41 HP), 5042D PowerPro (44 HP), 5045D PowerPro (46 HP) | 
50 HP and above | ₹1,50,000 | 5050D (50 HP), 5310 (57 HP), 5405 (63 HP), 5075E (76 HP) | 

Subsidy amounts are set by the Government of Odisha and are paid only after DBT approval. Implements such as rotavators and cultivators have their own subsidy under the same programme.

## Who can apply?
Any farmer in Odisha with a valid Farmer ID can apply, whatever the land size. Groups such as Pani Panchayats, women’s self-help groups and cooperatives can apply through a nominated member.
Two rules to know before you apply:
- You must keep the tractor for 5 years. Selling it earlier can lead to recovery of the subsidy.
- Tractor-drawn implements are only for tractor owners, one of each type per tractor registration.

## What documents do you need?
- Farmer ID (Krushak Odisha)
- Aadhaar linked to your Farmer ID
- Aadhaar linked to your bank account (the subsidy is paid through the Aadhaar-Based Payment System)
- Your registered mobile number, for the OTPs at every step
- For a bank loan: the lender’s usual papers, such as land records, bank statements, PAN and photographs
If your Farmer ID is not linked to Aadhaar, your Block Agriculture Officer can add it.

## How to apply, step by step
- Register. Register on Krushak Odisha and Go-Sugam (sugam.odisha.gov.in) with your Farmer ID, Aadhaar and mobile number.
- Log in to FM-DBT. From 2026-27, tractors are booked and permits issued on the FM-DBT portal (fmdbt.agriodisha.nic.in). Log in with your Farmer ID and Aadhaar and confirm the OTP.
- Book while Ganjam has target. Bookings open in phases and are held for 10 days.
- Choose make, model and dealer. Select John Deere, your model and Sabita Traders from the dealers listed for Ganjam. We give you an offer price the same day.
- Print the permit. It is valid for 30 days if you pay yourself, or 45 days with a bank loan.
- Pay and take delivery. Pay online, or your bank issues a delivery order. Delivery is done with Aadhaar verification, within the permit’s validity.
- Verification. We upload GPS-tagged photos and the invoice. Some machines are physically inspected.
- Subsidy credited. The subsidy is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account.
Not sure about the portal? We will help you book.
Send us your village and the tractor you have in mind. We check Ganjam’s target, help you book on FM-DBT and arrange the loan before the permit clock starts.
WhatsApp 89085 89085

## When are new tractor targets released?
Each district, Ganjam included, gets a yearly target for each machine. From the Agriculture Department’s 31 Oct 2026 notice, new tractor targets under the State Pool are uploaded twice a month:
Month | Target top-up dates | 
November 2026 | 2 Nov and 16 Nov (done) | 
December 2026 | 1 Dec and 15 Dec | 
January 2027 | 1 Jan and 15 Jan | 

On those days the portal is closed from 2 PM to 3 PM, and tractor booking reopens at 3 PM. Targets can fill quickly, so keep your documents ready and book early.

## Key time limits
Booking held | 10 days | 
Permit, paying yourself | 30 days | 
Permit, with a bank loan | 45 days | 
Change of model | Once, within 25 days | 
If the permit lapses | Re-apply after 3 months | 

## Can you take the subsidy with a tractor loan?
Yes. Start the loan file before you book, because the bank must issue the delivery order within the 45-day permit. If the loan is late, the permit can lapse and you would have to wait 3 months to re-apply.
We work with John Deere Financial, banks and finance companies. Use our EMI calculator to plan the down payment and instalments.

## What if the farmer dies before delivery?
From the procedure posted on the FM-DBT portal on 5 Nov 2026: if the farmer paid but died before the online supply was completed, a legal heir can get the subsidy and the machine. The spouse comes first, unless they authorise another heir by notarised affidavit.
The heir submits the death certificate, the legal heir certificate from the Tahasildar, an NOC affidavit if there are several heirs, and their own Aadhaar, Voter ID, Farmer ID and bank details at the CDAO office. A district committee checks them and the subsidy is paid into the heir’s bank account.

## Questions farmers ask us
How much subsidy do I get on a John Deere 5045D?
The 5045D PowerPro is 46 HP, so it falls in the up-to-48 HP band: ₹1,20,000, subject to eligibility and DBT approval.
How much subsidy do I get on a 50 HP tractor like the 5050D?
₹1,50,000. Tractors of 50 HP and above get the higher amount, subject to eligibility and DBT approval.
Where do I apply for the Odisha tractor subsidy?
Register once on Go-Sugam, then book the tractor and get the permit on the FM-DBT portal, fmdbt.agriodisha.nic.in. We can guide you through it.
When is the next tractor booking date in Ganjam?
New tractor targets are uploaded on 1 Dec and 15 Dec 2026, and on 1 Jan and 15 Jan 2027. Booking reopens at 3 PM on those days.
How long is the subsidy permit valid?
30 days if you pay yourself and 45 days if you buy with a bank loan. Finish payment and delivery within that time.
Can I sell the tractor after taking the subsidy?
You must keep it for 5 years. Selling it earlier can lead to recovery of the subsidy.
Is Sabita Traders an enlisted dealer for Ganjam?
Yes. Sabita Traders in Berhampur is the only authorised John Deere tractor dealer for Ganjam district. Select us from the dealers listed for Ganjam on the portal.
ABOUT THE AUTHOR
M Krishna Reddy is the Managing Director of Sabita Traders, the only authorised John Deere tractor dealer for Ganjam district, on NH 5 at Pathara Bypass Junction, Berhampur. His team helps Ganjam farmers with tractor choice, loans and the Odisha DBT subsidy application.

Sources: Government of Odisha, Operational Modality for DBT in Farm Mechanisation (2024 and 2026); FM-DBT portal notices of 31 Oct 2026 (tractor target top-ups) and 5 Nov 2026 (legal-heir procedure, SOP letter dated 8 Dec 2025); FM-DBT portal announcements (Aug 2026, Aadhaar-Based Payment System); subsidy amounts as applied at Sabita Traders, Nov 2026; tractor HP from John Deere India (deere.co.in). Rules can change: check the FM-DBT portal or ask us before you book.
